newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: SOCCER-DRUGS CHECK ON ASIAN PLAYERS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DRUGS CHECK ON ASIAN PLAYERS.

text.p: Dope tests are planned on all players involved in the South East Asia Games, the Asian Football Confederation said on Tuesday.
AFC secretary-general Peter Vellapan said the tests must be conducted before the players left for the Jakarta tournament on October 6-18.
"We want the Jakarta SEA Games football tournament to be free of any drug abuse. The most severe penalty possible will be meted out to a player caught for drug abuse," Vellapan said.
He said national associations would not be spared. "We are also placing the onus on the national associations to ensure that the objective of a drugs free tournament is met," he added.
Thailand, Burma, Cambodia, Brunei, Singapore, Vietnam, Malaysia, Laos and Indonesia are participating in the biennial Games.
